# Antioch east

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to DPT - Antioch East!

At our Antioch East physical therapy clinic, we provide compassionate, evidence-based care. Every patient receives individualized treatment from an expert clinician. Whether you’re recovering from injury or surgery or simply addressing a longtime ache or pain that keeps you from optimal function, we’re here to help you get better, faster!

We have therapists trained in ASTYM soft tissue mobilization and we work with a variety of populations including CrossFit participants.

We are located Between Menards and the Walmart Supercenter off of Route 173 in Antioch.  We carry on the tradition of DPT excellence here!

Our expert team of clinicians can take on most of your PT needs – we also specialize in your post-surgical rehabilitation, work or sport injuries, and therapy for a variety of age groups.

### We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

417 E. IL Rte 173

Unit 101

Antioch IL 60002

### Get In touch

Phone: 847-798-6096

Fax: 847-787-9557
